attributes.title: deal

stage.title: Stage
stage.xClarifyAIDescription: The deal's position in the sales pipeline. A winning stage (e.g. 'Won') indicates a paying customer. Stages are workspace-customizable: they can be renamed, reordered, and extended with custom stages. Only change the stage when there is a clear signal the deal has actually moved. Do not advance a deal to a winning or final stage, or move it backward, based on indirect signals such as billing, upgrade, or 'planning to' messages.

amount.title: Amount
amount.xClarifyAIDescription: The committed, actual monetary value of this deal (e.g. a signed contract or order-form value). Only set or change this once the value is genuinely agreed. Never write a projected, expected, or estimated number here, and do not overwrite an existing amount unless the deal value has actually changed.

close_date.title: Close date
close_date.xClarifyAIDescription: The expected or actual date when this deal closes. Use this column when filtering deals by time period for sales reports.

attributes.xClarifyAIDescription: Deals represent sales opportunities with companies. A deal with a winning stage (e.g. 'Won') represents a paying customer.

attributes.title: user
attributes.xClarifyAIDescription: This table represents users of Clarify. You should use it if the prompt includes 'I' or 'me'.

description.title: Description
description.xClarifyAIDescription: A description of what the task involves and why it matters, including any relevant context or next steps. Always populate this when creating a task.

name.title: Name
name.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's display name. May include legal suffixes (S.r.l., AB, BV, AS, LLC, Ltd) and may be in any language. Examples: 'Interwell S.r.l.', 'Bionic Sweden AB', 'Altec Asesoría'.

summary.title: Summary
summary.xClarifyAIDescription: A short tagline or one-liner summarizing what the company does. Often the LinkedIn tagline. May be in any language. Examples: 'Audit | Tax | Advisory', 'We move it faster', 'Decisions Made Simple'. This is a full-text search field: ILIKE matches whole words or phrases, and NOT ILIKE excludes them.

website.title: Website
website.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's primary website domain. Typically a bare domain without protocol (e.g. 'interwell.it', 'bionicems.se', 'integra-ca.co.zw').

linkedin.title: LinkedIn
linkedin.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's LinkedIn slug (the part after linkedin.com/company/). Examples: 'interwell-s-r-l', 'bionicsweden', 'integra-chartered-accountants'. Not a full URL.

description.title: Description
description.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's full description, typically from their LinkedIn page. Free-text, may be in any language, can be multiple paragraphs. Describes what the company does, its products/services, and value proposition. This is a full-text search field: ILIKE matches whole words or phrases, and NOT ILIKE excludes them.

canonical_name.title: Canonical name
canonical_name.xClarifyAIDescription: A URL-friendly slug derived from the company name, lowercased with spaces replaced by hyphens. Examples: 'interwell-s-r-l', 'bionicsweden', 'altec-asesoría'. Often matches the LinkedIn slug.

linkedin_slugs.title: LinkedIn slugs
linkedin_slugs.xClarifyAIDescription: All LinkedIn company page slugs associated with this company (the part after linkedin.com/company/). Includes current and historical slugs. Examples: 'interwell-s-r-l', 'bionicsweden'.

contact_info_url.title: Contact URL
contact_info_url.xClarifyAIDescription: URL to the company's contact page. Usually includes '/contact' in the path. Examples: 'www.hotelflorescente.com/contacto.html', 'infotekhealthcare.com/contact-us/', 'hrebel.com.au/contact'.

alternative_names.title: Alternative names
alternative_names.xClarifyAIDescription: Other names the company is known by, including trade names, former names, or localized variants. Often includes the same value as the primary name.

contact_info_email.title: Contact email
contact_info_email.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's public contact email address. Typically a generic address like info@, sales@, support@, or contact@. Examples: person-1@example.com', person-2@example.com', person-3@example.com'.

contact_info_phone.title: Contact phone
contact_info_phone.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's public contact phone number. Format varies by country, may include international prefix. Examples: '+39-444-886289', '1 212-961-7767', '+91 93849 39396', '(408) 677-8895'.

tech_stack_products.title: Tech stack products
tech_stack_products.xClarifyAIDescription: Software products and technologies detected in the company's tech stack. Lowercase names of frameworks, libraries, platforms, and tools. Examples: 'react', 'google analytics', 'amazon web services', 'wordpress', 'hubspot', 'nginx'.

workforce_headcount.title: Workforce headcount
workforce_headcount.xClarifyAIDescription: Sparsely populated. For filtering or querying companies by employee count or company size (e.g. 'fewer than 500 employees'), do not filter on this numeric column -- use the `employee_range` enum with IN, selecting only the buckets fully contained within the requested range.

identifiers_cage_code.title: CAGE code
identifiers_cage_code.xClarifyAIDescription: Commercial and Government Entity code. A 5-character alphanumeric identifier used by the US Department of Defense to identify suppliers.

identifiers_duns_code.title: DUNS code
identifiers_duns_code.xClarifyAIDescription: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number. A unique 9-digit numeric identifier assigned to a single business entity.

identifiers_naics_code.title: NAICS code
identifiers_naics_code.xClarifyAIDescription: North American Industry Classification System code. A 2-6 digit numeric string classifying the company's industry (e.g. '541511' for Custom Computer Programming Services).

identifiers_stock_ticker.title: Stock ticker
identifiers_stock_ticker.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's stock ticker symbol if publicly traded. Short uppercase alphanumeric code (e.g. 'AAPL', 'MSFT').

about.title: About
about.xClarifyAIDescription: The person's professional bio or summary, typically from their LinkedIn 'About' section. Free-text, may be in any language, can be multiple paragraphs. Describes experience, skills, certifications, and career highlights. This is a full-text search field: ILIKE matches whole words or phrases, and NOT ILIKE excludes them.

score.title: Email score
score.description: Confidence that this email address is valid and deliverable, based on cross-referencing multiple independent data sources.

tiers.label: High
tiers.description: This email was verified across multiple data sources. It is the highest-confidence result and is ready to use in outreach.

tiers.label: Medium
tiers.description: This email was found in at least one data source but couldn't be fully cross-referenced. When used in Campaigns, Clarify validates it before sending to protect your domain reputation.

tiers.label: Low
tiers.description: This email appeared in a data source but couldn't be cross-referenced. When used in Campaigns, Clarify validates it before sending to protect your domain reputation.

score.xClarifyAIDescription: Email confidence score (0-1) indicating deliverability confidence. Displayed as Low (<0.5), Medium (0.5-0.75), or High (≥0.75).

hiring.title: Hiring
hiring.xClarifyAIDescription: Whether the person is currently hiring.

skills.title: Skills
skills.xClarifyAIDescription: Professional skills listed on the person's profile. Free-text labels, may be in any language. Examples: 'Construction', 'Contract Management', 'Project Management', 'Microsoft Office', 'Neuroscience', 'Gestione delle risorse umane'.

headline.title: Headline
headline.xClarifyAIDescription: The person's LinkedIn headline. Typically follows the pattern 'Job Title at Company Name' but can be free-text with taglines, multiple roles, or personal branding statements. May be in any language. This is a full-text search field: ILIKE matches whole words or phrases, and NOT ILIKE excludes them.

linkedin.title: LinkedIn
linkedin.xClarifyAIDescription: The person's LinkedIn profile slug (the part after linkedin.com/in/). Examples: 'pat-cahill-1b63b6b5', 'benjamin-wagner-7363238'. Not a full URL.

job_title.title: Job title
job_title.xClarifyAIDescription: The person's current job title as listed on their professional profile. Free-text, may be in any language. Examples: 'Contracts Manager', 'Senior Technical Support Engineer', 'Product Specialist', 'Substitute Teacher', 'Psicóloga'. This is a full-text search field: ILIKE matches whole words or phrases, and NOT ILIKE excludes them.

smart_tags.title: Smart tags
smart_tags.xClarifyAIDescription: System-generated camelCase tags indicating notable career signals. Known values: 'oneYearAtCurrentCompany', 'employeeDuringIPO', 'employeeDuringMA', 'employeeDuringBigMA', 'bigTechAlumPrivate', 'bigTechAlumPublic', 'topUniversity', 'USImmigrant'.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.xClarifyAIDescription: The name of the company where the person currently works. Free-text, may include legal suffixes (LLC, Ltd, Inc, S.r.l.) and may be in any language. Examples: 'UT Southwestern', 'Ben E. Keith Foods', 'INAIL, Istituto Nazionale Assicurazione contro gli Infortuni sul Lavoro'.

open_to_work.title: Open to work
open_to_work.xClarifyAIDescription: Whether the person is open to work.

company_website.title: Company website
company_website.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's website domain or URL. May be a bare domain (e.g. 'benekeith.com') or include a path (e.g. 'inail.it/cs/internet/home.html').

company_linkedin.title: Company LinkedIn
company_linkedin.xClarifyAIDescription: The company's LinkedIn identifier. Can be a slug (e.g. 'nrt-carpentry-contractors', 'inail') or a numeric ID (e.g. '6504'). Not a full URL.

investor_data_geo_focus.title: Investor geo focus
investor_data_geo_focus.xClarifyAIDescription: The geographic regions or countries where the investor focuses their investments. Only populated for persons with investor_data_type set. Free-text.

investor_data_industry_focus.title: Investor industry focus
investor_data_industry_focus.xClarifyAIDescription: The industries or sectors where the investor focuses their investments. Only populated for persons with investor_data_type set. Free-text.
